title: Gemini 3.6 Flash and 3.5 Flash-Lite GA: sampling parameters deprecated
description: Gemini 3.6 Flash and 3.5 Flash-Lite are now generally available with stable model IDs (gemini-3.6-flash, gemini-3.5-flash-lite). Importantly, the sampling parameters temperature, top_p, and top_k are now deprecated for the latest Gemini models. ellmer may need to update default model references and handle/warn about deprecated parameters in its chat interface.

title: Claude Opus 5 released — candidate for new default model
description: Anthropic released Claude Opus 5 on July 24, 2026, described as a step-change improvement for long-running agents with improvements in coding and professional work. ellmer may want to evaluate updating its default model references for the Opus tier to claude-opus-5 (or whatever the API model string is).

title: DeepSeek-V4-Flash official public beta release with Responses API support
description: DeepSeek-V4-Flash (deepseek-v4-flash) is now in official public beta as of 2026-07-31. Notably, it natively supports the Responses API format, which is a new API surface that ellmer may need to handle or document. Enhanced agent/tool-calling capabilities are also highlighted.

title: Ollama adds Anthropic Messages API compatibility
description: Ollama now supports the Anthropic Messages API, enabling tools like Claude Code to use local open models via Ollama. ellmer's chat_ollama may need to consider whether this new API surface affects how ellmer interacts with Ollama, though it primarily affects users routing Anthropic-compatible clients through Ollama.

title: Ollama native image input support (DFlash)
description: Ollama's MLX engine now includes native DFlash and image input support for multimodal models, announced alongside the Muse Glimmer release. This may affect how ellmer handles image/vision inputs when using Ollama as a backend, if the API surface for sending images has changed.

title: Perplexity Gateway API and Agent API introduced
description: Perplexity has added a Gateway API (with routing and reliability features) and an Agent API (with tool use support) to their platform. These represent new API surfaces that ellmer's Perplexity provider may need to support, particularly the Agent API's tool-calling capabilities which are relevant to ellmer's tool-use functionality.

title: Perplexity Embeddings API introduced
description: Perplexity now offers an Embeddings API with standard and contextualized embeddings. This is a new API surface that could be relevant if ellmer adds embedding support for the Perplexity provider.

title: Gemini 3.6 Flash and 3.5 Flash-Lite GA released
description: Stable versions of gemini-3.6-flash and gemini-3.5-flash-lite are now generally available. These may be candidates for updating ellmer's default Gemini model references if they supersede previously recommended models.

title: Claude Sonnet 5 released — candidate for new default model
description: Anthropic announced Claude Sonnet 5 on June 30, 2026, described as delivering frontier performance across coding, agents, and professional work at scale. As a new flagship Sonnet-tier model, ellmer may need to consider updating its default model for the claude_sonnet family.

title: Ollama supports streaming responses with tool calling
description: Ollama now supports streaming responses with tool calling, enabling chat applications to stream content and call tools in real time. ellmer's Ollama integration may need to be updated to support or document this streaming tool-calling capability.

title: Ollama adds thinking enable/disable control
description: Ollama added the ability to enable or disable thinking for models that support it, giving users control over reasoning behavior. ellmer may need to expose this parameter in its Ollama chat interface.

title: Ollama adds web search API
description: Ollama introduced a new web search API, providing a free tier for individuals and higher rate limits via Ollama's cloud. ellmer may need to consider whether to expose or document this capability in its Ollama provider.
